Manectric

Electric

Hoenn · Generation 3

Manectric is an Electric-type Discharge Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 40.2 kg. It evolves from Electrike. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (105), with a base stat total of 475.
